subject.title: moltbot.json in ~/.openclaw/ silently dropped on upgrade to v2026.3.22+ causing blank UI and crash-loop

question: Should OpenClaw accept the bounded doctor recovery for sibling `.openclaw/moltbot.json` via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94185?
rationale: The issue is a valid upgrade regression, but the linked fix intentionally revives recovery for a retired config filename and may replace a skeletal canonical config with credential-bearing legacy content.

options.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
options.body: Accept the compatibility exception because VISION.md and AGENTS.md both put invalidated config repair in doctor migration rather than runtime fallback.

options.title: Require Narrower Fix Mode
options.body: Keep the issue open and require the linked PR to further restrict recovery writes if maintainers want read-only doctor to remain non-mutating.

options.title: Decline Legacy Filename Recovery
options.body: Close the linked PR and update this issue with a manual migration path if maintainers want `moltbot.json` to remain fully retired.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility exception because VISION.md and AGENTS.md both put invalidated config repair in doctor migration rather than runtime fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant removal, config-path, and startup-guard history points most strongly to this area owner for the compatibility tradeoff.
